rows.text: • Raising and narrowing full-year adjusted EPS outlook to a range of $7.23-$7.38, from $6.85-$7.05, reflecting broad-based outperformance.

The strengthening performance in PFT, continued momentum in AAT, and significant outperformance from our recent acquisitions drove record adjusted EPS of $2.05, setting us up for a record full-year outlook.
